title: As truth awakens From a slumber Of their souls Whispers of stories hang on threads. While the yarn unwinds two needlepoints pushed away.
summary: As truth awakens From a slumber Of their souls Whispers of stories hang on threads. While the yarn unwinds two needlepoints pushed away.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
As truth awakens
From a slumber
Of their souls
Whispers of stories
hang on threads.
While the yarn unwinds
two needlepoints pushed away.
